text:
Ivy Chen: I opened a compact PR that combines the quotas + pricing ledgers info and swaps all old snippets for the v2 SDK. It also adds a short section on tenant-level ledger attribution and a downloadable Grafana panel JSON. https://github.com/redwoodinference/docs/pull/958 :sparkles:
Marcus Lee: nice. two asks: 1) add a worked numeric example for reserved + burst + payg across tenants, 2) ensure the panel JSON matches the query in the code snippet (we've shipped mismatches before).
Ivy Chen: yep on both. For the worked example I'm planning a 3-row table: request size, reserved applied, burst applied, remainder billed. Short and concrete.
Priyanka Rao: heads-up  some snippets still use header `X-Metering`. v2 expects `X-RW-Metering-Context`. Also the recommended fluent API is `client.withQuota({tier:"..."})` not manual header injection.
Ivy Chen: thanks, I'll grep-replace and switch to the fluent call.
ops-bot: linter: found deprecated header `X-Metering` in usage/ledgers.md lines 58 and 124. Also panel JSON has field "metric_name": "billing.requests_by_ledger" but snippet query uses "billing.requests_ledger_total".
Marcus Lee: please align the metric keys. In the migration note we should include the old->new metric map so customers can update dashboards easily.
Ivy Chen: adding a small mapping table under "Migration notes". I'll regenerate the panel JSON and attach it to the PR.
Priyanka Rao: for Dedicated/on-prem customers, add a one-line callout: "On-prem agents <=v3.1 continue to emit X-Metering; upgrade to agent v3.2+ to get X-RW-Metering-Context." Link the agent changelog.
Ivy Chen: added that bullet and linked the release notes. Kept it short so it stays visible.
Marcus Lee: can we also add a parenthetical clarifying embeddings billing? e.g., "Embeddings are billed per vector unit, not tokens" — customers confuse this.
Ivy Chen: added as a parenthetical with a link to embeddings billing.
Priyanka Rao: one more nit: use single backticks for inline flags and fenced blocks for full snippet blocks. Our docs linter will complain otherwise.
Ivy Chen: standardized formatting across the page.
docs-bot: PR 958 updated by ivy  replaced headers, added migration map, standardized formatting. snippet-check: failed (missing mock fixture).
Marcus Lee: I can add a tiny offline fixture that instantiates a mocked v2 client and asserts the header and `.withQuota()` call. No network. Will push to the branch.
Priyanka Rao: also ensure the fixture checks that the panel JSON's query string includes `by_ledger` if we document that metric name. Little tests prevent bad copy-paste.
Marcus Lee: good idea. I'll assert metric name equality between the panel JSON and the example query in the test.
ops-bot: added a CI note: don't forget to include the panel JSON in the docs assets so Netlify preview can render it.
Ivy Chen: will attach the panel JSON under static/images/panels and reference it in the markdown.
Marcus Lee: pushed fixture and small test -> branch. https://github.com/redwoodinference/docs/pull/958/files#diff-33. No network calls, just string checks.
docs-bot: snippet-check: pass after Marcus' fixture. preview: https://deploy-preview-958--docs.redwood.ai/usage/ledgers-quota-pricing
Priyanka Rao: preview looks good. the worked example numbers are clear. One suggestion: expand the migration map to include example Grafana query replace commands (sed one-liner) to make it easy for SREs.
Ivy Chen: added a short sed snippet under migration that replaces old->new metric names. Example: `sed -i 's/billing.requests_by_ledger/billing.requests_ledger_total/g' dashboard.json`. Kept it as an inline fenced block.
Marcus Lee: LGTM from infra. Once Netlify finishes, please ping #support so they can update canned responses and the KB.
Ivy Chen: will do. merging after preview finishes. Follow-ups: add the fixture to docs-test-suite and notify #eng-runtime about header rename so agents don't surprise support. :tada:
